name: Event Log
description: One typed log of what happened in the galaxy — every scenario message and news story and the game's own empire messages and NewsNet broadcasts, with category, importance, actors and place — behind the Galactic History screen's category filter and importance sort and the chronicle digest. Includes the Internal Security scenario (and with it the Emergent Galaxy packages and hidden threats; their own flags).
